fusions.name: The Wait Ends
fusions.desc: Surges up from below with jaws shut on the target, which deals 30 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Engulfing Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges with jaws agape, which deals 13 damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Logging
fusions.desc: Lies still at the surface: veils you for 9 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Unhurried Jaw
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
